_comment: SHARED FIXTURE - identical bytes in all four frameworks.
One answer key for feature 1 of the feature audit (the .env parser).
The .env CONTENT lives here too, as `env_file`, rather than in a sibling
file. One file means one thing to keep in sync: a fixture whose input and
expectations can drift apart is not an answer key. Each suite writes it to a
temp directory and loads it for real - a .env is a file, so the real
dependency is trivially available and there is nothing to mock.
Three of these lines were silent bugs in Ruby before this row: an export
prefix dropped the variable entirely, a trailing comment stayed in the value,
and ${VAR} never expanded anywhere but PHP.
env_file:
PLAIN=hello
export EXPORTED=shellstyle
QUOTED="double quoted"
SINGLE='single quoted'
HOST=example.com
INTERP=${HOST}/api
DQ_INTERP="${HOST}/v2"
LITERAL='${HOST}/api'
WITH_HASH=value # trailing comment
QUOTED_HASH="a # b"
UNKNOWN=${NOPE}/x
EMPTY=
ESCAPES="line1\nline2\ttabbed"
SPACED_KEY = spaced
no_equals_sign
1BAD=invalid key

_never_set._note: Keys that must NOT exist after loading. A malformed line is skipped with a warning, never guessed at, and one bad line never stops the rest of the file.

_rules.export_prefix: A shell-style `export FOO=bar` is valid input. Ruby dropped these lines entirely and said nothing, so a .env copied out of a shell profile lost keys and the failure surfaced somewhere unrelated.
_rules.trailing_comment: An unquoted value ends at the first SPACE-HASH. Ruby kept the whole line, so `value # note` became 'value # note' - a wrong value rather than an absent one, which is the harder kind to notice.
_rules.quoted_hash: A `#` inside quotes is part of the value, not a comment.
_rules.interpolation: ${VAR} expands in unquoted and double-quoted values against keys already loaded plus the real environment. It was PHP-only, so a .env written against PHP produced a broken literal in the other three.
_rules.single_quotes_are_verbatim: No escapes, no expansion. This is the documented way to keep a literal ${...} and the migration path for the breaking half of the change.
_rules.unresolved_reference: Left LITERAL and warned about once per name, never resolved to an empty string. PHP emptied it, so `URL=${DB_HOST}/db` with a typo silently became '/db'.
_rules.empty_value: `EMPTY=` sets the empty string. It does not unset and it is not absent.
_rules.escapes: A double-quoted value processes \n, \t and \\. A single-quoted one does not.
_rules.spaced_key: Whitespace around the key is trimmed.

precedence._note: real environment > .env.local > .env, first-wins. A stray gitignored .env.local must never clobber an explicitly-set production variable.
